hook: Cable TV, but weirder — and completely free

beats.say: Spelunkr is a free TV network built from the Internet Archive's forgotten videos, streaming an endless supply of odd and overlooked footage around the clock.
Its live channels run 24 hours a day, synchronized, so everyone watching sees the same thing at the same time.
It is cable TV, but weirder — a second life for footage that would otherwise sit unseen in the archive.
